# CrossNotes — Maharashtra Board Class 10 Study App

CrossNotes is a free Progressive Web App for Maharashtra State Board Class 10 (SSC) students. It provides chapter-by-chapter study notes, flashcards, MCQs, gamified XP/streaks/leaderboard, official board papers, and offline support via a service worker. Content is in English (with Marathi and Hindi support).

## Key Pages

- [Dashboard](https://cross-notes-crossnotes-i2u7.vercel.app/): XP bar, streak ring, leaderboard preview, subject quick-links
- [All Subjects](https://cross-notes-crossnotes-i2u7.vercel.app/subjects): Listing of every subject
- [Science 1](https://cross-notes-crossnotes-i2u7.vercel.app/subject/science-1): Chapter list for Science 1
- [Resource Vault](https://cross-notes-crossnotes-i2u7.vercel.app/vault): Official board papers and downloadables
- [My Progress](https://cross-notes-crossnotes-i2u7.vercel.app/progress): Personal progress and weak-chapter tracking
- [Leaderboard](https://cross-notes-crossnotes-i2u7.vercel.app/leaderboard): Global XP leaderboard
- [Coin Shop](https://cross-notes-crossnotes-i2u7.vercel.app/shop): Boosts and cosmetics earned with coins

## Subjects

- Science 1
- Science 2
- Maths 1 (Algebra)
- Maths 2 (Geometry)
- History
- Geography
- English
- Hindi
- Marathi

## Tech Stack

- React + Vite + TailwindCSS
- Firebase Authentication (Google sign-in) and Cloud Firestore
- Deployed on Vercel with a service worker for offline study
- Lazy-loaded route chunks keep the initial bundle small

## Accessibility

- All interactive controls are keyboard-focusable with visible focus
- Semantic HTML with ARIA roles used only where needed
- Touch targets are at least 44px
- Live regions announce dynamic content (Mew companion nudges, tour progress)
